abstract: Verifies high-pressure steam off-take schedules and baseload delivery guarantees
system_message:
You are the Refinery utility operations manager (OPS), responsible for verifying high-pressure steam off-take schedules and baseload delivery guarantees.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Turbomachinery vibration diagnostics（VIBR）
information_points.content:
OPS-VIBR-YTJ：For Vanguard Industrial Thermodynamics, the peak bearing vibration velocity across primary expander turbine bearing housings is 4.8 mm/s root mean square vibration velocity under rated thermal load.
OPS-VIBR-D61：For AeroThermal CleanPower Solutions, the peak bearing vibration velocity across primary expander turbine bearing housings is 3.4 mm/s root mean square vibration velocity under rated thermal load.
OPS-VIBR-Y90：For Nordic FlueGas Recovery Consortium, the peak bearing vibration velocity across primary expander turbine bearing housings is 2.1 mm/s root mean square vibration velocity under rated thermal load.

information_points.title: Verifies high-pressure steam off-take schedules and baseload delivery guarantees（STEAM）
information_points.content:
OPS-STEAM-IQV：For Vanguard Industrial Thermodynamics, the guaranteed annual steam delivery commitment is not verified under superheated medium-pressure steam headers (40 bar, 380 deg C) with formal underwriting of liquidated damages for shortfalls below 450000 metric tons annual steam.
OPS-STEAM-X6O：For AeroThermal CleanPower Solutions, the guaranteed annual steam delivery commitment is verified under superheated medium-pressure steam headers (40 bar, 380 deg C) with formal underwriting of liquidated damages for shortfalls below 450000 metric tons annual steam.
OPS-STEAM-QV3：For Nordic FlueGas Recovery Consortium, the guaranteed annual steam delivery commitment is verified under superheated medium-pressure steam headers (40 bar, 380 deg C) with formal underwriting of liquidated damages for shortfalls below 450000 metric tons annual steam.
